Chess Clock Timer

A two-player chess clock with tap-to-switch, optional increment per move, flag detection, pause and reset.

Tap a side to start. Tap your own side after your move.

📖 How to use

  1. Set the starting minutes and optional increment seconds.
  2. Tap either side to start the other player's clock.
  3. After each move, the player taps their own side to switch.
  4. Pause or Reset anytime from the buttons below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I switch the clock?

Tap the clock of the player who just moved. Their clock stops, the increment is added, and the opponent's clock starts.

How does the game start?

Set minutes and increment, then tap either side to start — the other player's clock begins running.

What happens when time runs out?

Yes — when a clock reaches zero it flags: the timer stops, the side flashes red and a sound plays.

How does the increment work?

Fischer increment: the seconds you set are added to a player's clock every time they tap their side.
